identity_rule: One business variable maps to one ASS id. A conflicting value reuses the existing ASS id after confirmation; it never creates a second ASS for the same variable.
turn_rule: A proposed replacement and its valid confirmation must come from two separate user turns. The turn that proposes the new value cannot also authorize the write.
raw_idea_rule: 00_idea-discovery/raw-idea.md is verbatim history and is never rewritten retroactively.

NO_CONFLICT.meaning: No persisted official value exists for the variable, or the proposed value matches the persisted value.

CONFLICT_DETECTED_AWAITING_CONFIRMATION.meaning: A persisted official value exists and the user proposed a different value.
CONFLICT_DETECTED_AWAITING_CONFIRMATION.confirmation_prompt: Rispondi in un turno successivo con una conferma esplicita, ad esempio: 'Confermo esplicitamente la sostituzione di <variabile> da <vecchio valore> a <nuovo valore>'. Qualunque risposta ambigua lascia invariato il valore persistito.

CHANGE_CONFIRMED.meaning: The user confirmed the exact replacement in a later turn.

CHANGE_REJECTED_OR_UNCONFIRMED.meaning: The user rejected the change or answered ambiguously.

decision_log_rule: Only CHANGE_CONFIRMED writes a final DEC entry for the replacement. CONFLICT_DETECTED_AWAITING_CONFIRMATION and CHANGE_REJECTED_OR_UNCONFIRMED do not append a final decision.
history_rule: On CHANGE_CONFIRMED, preserve the prior official value in the same ASS entry before updating the current value.
